passage:
Dear Community Tool Library Team,

I am writing to let you know about a problem with a recent tool rental and to ask for help with my annual membership. I have been a happy member of our local tool library for over two years, and I usually love borrowing equipment for my weekend home projects. However, my experience last weekend was quite frustrating.

Last Friday, I reserved an electric hedge trimmer for a quick Saturday morning yard cleanup. When I arrived to pick it up, the front desk staff member seemed rushed and handed me the equipment bag without checking it together first. When I got home and plugged the trimmer in, I quickly realized the power cord had a deep cut near the plug, making it unsafe to use. Because I did not want to risk an electrical short, I had to stop my project completely and return the tool right away.

When I brought it back, the staff member on duty seemed to think I caused the damage. She suggested I might have to pay a repair fee, even though the cut was clearly old and covered with cheap electrical tape that I had missed during the hurried pickup. After some quick discussion, she agreed not to charge me this time, but the whole situation left a bad impression.

As a regular community member, I always take good care of the equipment I borrow and return everything clean and on time. It is disappointing to be treated like I caused damage that was already there.

Because I lost my entire Saturday morning and could not finish my yard work, I am asking for two things to make this right:

Please review the intake inspection process so that staff members properly check tools with members before they leave the shop.

Extend my current annual membership by one month to make up for the lost rental time and the hassle.

I really value having a tool library in our neighborhood and want to see it succeed. I just want to make sure that equipment checks are done more carefully in the future.

Thank you for your time and understanding. I look forward to your reply.

Sincerely,
Rachel Vance
Member ID: #44890
